answer: Each claim must carry an ember kindled only from its own verified jobs, paying 75 POA burned to light it. The ember hangs in a cedar lantern on the public ledger, where peers read its flame against the ledger line that fed it. A copied ember burns the wrong color and the claim drops with its 75 POA burned. Each ember is kindled from the ash of the claim before it, so clones must light their lanterns one by one, and fuel grows with the cube of the kindling's place: 10 clones cost 226,875 POA; an ember from one ledger line cannot light a lantern on another.
